penalties.details: The Company has received an Order from the Office of the Assessment Unit, Income Tax Department Raised a demand of Rs. 41,75,88,940/-. The issue pertains to disallowance of claim of Waiver of interest on working capital Loan in onetime settlement as non-taxable under section 41 of the Income tax Act,1961, pertaining to the assessment year 2018-2019.
penalties.impact: Considering the merits of the case, the Company intends to file appeal before the Appellate Authority within timelimit prescribed under the Law. The Company is hopeful of a favorable outcome thereof and does not expect the said Order to have any material financial impact on the Company.

tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed an appeal on 08-04-2026 against the order.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company has filed an appeal on 08-04-2026 against the order.
